source.scope: Saved snapshot footprint reconstruction. Current package hashes checked separately per map. Changed packages and source mesh dependencies require fresh Editor extraction. No Editor collision/Nav validation.
preservation_chain: Last complete saved Actor snapshots LooseLootExhibition20261003/M0x_after.json each match ExhibitVariation20261003/before.json map hash.

apply_exhibit_variation.py captures snapshot-based nonpainting records, validates exact nonpainting placement/components/security links before save and after reload; 60 canvas mesh/world transforms preserved.
ExhibitVariation20261003/apply.json records resulting map hashes; current .umap SHA256 checked equal on 2026-10-05.
Final SIE assignment QA verifies 60 candidates and preserved geometry; final BaseColor capture report independently matches resulting hashes.
source.applied_scope: 2026-10-07 user-approved Editor placement; derived Nav and runtime checks recorded separately

derived_navigation.scope: Final package hashes follow derived Recast save/reload. Per-map applied hashes and captures retain their placement-stage provenance. M01 existing eight patrol path failures and M02 existing five guard-floor overlaps remain strict failures; M02 graph-only 231 paths and M03 strict 98 paths passed. Natural User PIE, movement sweeps, interaction and multiplayer are not tested.

navigation_repair.scope: M01 two waypoint translations; M02 five guard Z corrections; M03 read-only regression
navigation_repair.provenance: Previous derived_navigation and per-map applied entries retain pre-repair stage hashes and failure evidence. Only navigation_repair records the latest saved map state.

runtime_observation.scope: Unforced SIE, direct one-player internal fallback, 75 game seconds each M01/M02; four active authored guards per map. Eight active guards moved, sampled floor penetration and partial Moving paths both zero. Inactive guard per map not expected to move.

detention_sentry.scope: One existing BP_Guard Medium resident and one single waypoint per map; existing detention patrol and all prior actors preserved

simulation_vent_repair.scope: M03 Vent interaction center repair; other actors and security layout unchanged
simulation_vent_repair.runtime_validation_scope: Actual two-player M03 PIE worlds, two scripted contract runs through grounded Vent settlement/extraction, result and lobby return; NullRHI, not human play or Steam

cctv_work_access_stage.scope: Latest camera orientation stage only; previous full-layout, Nav, security, detention and Vent stage records retain historical provenance.

저장된 건축 Bounds 기반 평면. 문틀은 열린 틀로 표시하며 AABB를 막힌 벽으로 취급하지 않음.
원본 메시 의존 에셋에 현재 삭제·수정이 있으므로 저장 스냅샷 외곽을 현재 실형상 검증으로 확대하지 않음.
새 Editor 추출·실제 Collision/Nav·경비 연결·광학 시야 검증이 아니며 실제 맵은 미수정.
